title: The knitted satellite
alt: A cream yarn satellite floats with blue stitched solar panels and a small grey dish.
description: A familiar mechanical object reinterpreted through knitted fibres, connected components and a clear material contrast.
prompt: A whimsical yet meticulously crafted satellite sculpture entirely made from knitted yarn, suspended in a dark blue studio. One central cream knitted cube has two flat rectangular blue solar-panel wings attached symmetrically at left and right, each with a regular stitched grid. A small silver-grey knitted dish on top points diagonally upward and connects to a short stalk. Visible knit loops, soft fibres and coherent connections, complete object visible, refined collectible design photograph, no lettering.
